Name: Radioactive Tools
Author: kakashigr
Description:
-----------------
Changelog
-----------------

v 1.2.7
New Radioactive Scythe, more powerful than the golden one. Sold from Krobus, need to have 6 hearts with him and be on year 2+
Partial Portuguese translation (thanks [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/79455738-ertila/]Ertila[/url])

﻿v 1.2.6
Fixed Radioactive Tree blooming in summer instead of spring ﻿(thx ﻿﻿[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/63305411-schneitizel/]Schneitizel[/url]﻿ )
Updated French Translation for new items ﻿(thx ﻿﻿[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/63305411-schneitizel/]Schneitizel[/url]﻿ )
Fixed translation bugs ﻿(thx ﻿﻿[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/63305411-schneitizel/]Schneitizel[/url]﻿ )﻿

v 1.2.5
Added new Radioactive Rod. Sold from Willy, need to have Iridium Rod in your inventory.
French Translation (thx ﻿﻿[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/63305411-schneitizel/]Schneitizel[/url]﻿ )
Code Cleanup

v 1.2.3
Added new Bar Grinder. It breaks down bars into ores (1 bar = 2 ores ). Recipe sold from Robin, needs year 2+
Now depends on Producer Framework

v 1.2.2 
Added new Radioactive Trees that produce radioactive ores. Saplings sold from Pierre, needs  year 2+ 
Adjusted Radioactive Potion stats

v 1.2.1:
Added new Radioactive Potion. Sold from the Dwarf, needs 6 hearts with him and year 2+

v 0.2:
Added new Radioactive Sword. Sold from Krobus, need to have 6 hearts with him and be on year 2+
Now depends on JSON Assets

v 0.1: Initial Release

Adds new radioactive tools upgrades to the game. Based entirely on [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/PrismaticTools]pathoschild's fork[/url]﻿﻿ of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools by stokastic[/url] with a few adjustments.

Source code available on [url=https://github.com/kakashigr/stardew-radioactivetools]github[/url]

Please note this is my first mod and I don't really know much about SV modding, however since I made this for myself, I decided to share it for anyone interested.
